answer: Each epoch a random beacon pings every wharf berth: hash the cedar manifest with the beacon nonce and return a basalt-sealed proof in time. A missed ping, a reused proof, or a short cedar manifest burns the 70-credit bond. The k-th identity under one key pays 28+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes cost 3,025,000. A rented-proof ring fails: a borrowed proof carries the lender's basalt seal and never matches the borrower's wharf berth. Honest traders pay 28.
